rootCause: The I6 control-plane guard hardcodes the historical B4 execution-lock path while CONTROL_PLANE now correctly points to the versioned R13 successor lock. The guard therefore compares the successor control binding against the historical file hash and fails before product contract execution.
requiredFix: Resolve the active B4 lock path from CONTROL_PLANE.i65ForensicRemediationPlan.b4.executionLockPath, require it to exist, and compare its exact blob against the control binding. Preserve the historical lock as required evidence.
